name: QRCode
summary: Scannable QR code rendered as a styled SVG with Aurea soft geometry.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern: a QR code is an image. It carries role="img", an aria-label and a <title>, because a scannable square is worth nothing to someone who cannot point a camera at it — always also offer the value it encodes as text or as a link nearby. The dark core is fixed and does not follow the theme: inverting it in dark mode breaks decoding on some readers.

props.name: value
props.description: REQUIRED. What the code encodes. It is also what the default accessible name reads out, so a reader that cannot scan still gets the payload.

props.name: size
props.description: 7.5rem, 10rem or 15rem, quiet zone included (the box is border-box). A free number is deliberately gone — it forced raw pixels on you. For an odd size, such as print, override --qr-size in CSS. PICK BY SCANNING, NOT BY LAYOUT: what decides is how many pixels each module gets, and below roughly 4 an ordinary phone camera starts to miss it. Measured on a short URL (33 modules across, quiet zone included): sm gives 2.85 px per module, md 4.06, lg 6.48 — sm is already under the line, and a longer payload makes every one of them worse, because more data means more modules in the same box.

props.name: ecc
props.description: Error correction. Higher than the usual default on purpose: round dots cover less area than squares, so more correction is what keeps this skin scannable.

props.name: quietZone
props.description: Blank border in modules, not pixels — it is part of the matrix, not of the layout. Four is the specified minimum; below it, scanners start failing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Replace the default when the value is a long opaque token and the purpose is what matters — "Ticket for row 12", not the token.
